title: Negative nouns with plural owners
focus: Practise the regular singular partitive with plural owners.
targetSkills: Regular singular partitive in negative possession

exercises.prompt: Choose the noun in “We do not have a cat.” Frame: “Meillä ei ole ___.” Use kissa (“a cat”).
exercises.explanation: Negative possession uses the singular partitive noun. For this regular word, kissa + -a = kissaa; keep both vowels when they meet.
requiredSkills: Fixed ei ole in possession
Regular singular partitive in negative possession
exercises.targetSkill: Regular singular partitive in negative possession
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Regular singular partitive in negative possession: form or meaning confused
